reference_motions: Observed real cat videos; pose/reference screenshots only; no original footage is shipped

prompts.stretch: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: photorealistic 2D desktop-cat animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the identity reference: Rousong, the exact brown mackerel tabby cat with large olive-green eyes, pale chin, brown nose, dense short fur and ringed tail. Image 2 is ONLY motion anatomy reference. Create a new transparent-background horizontal sprite sheet with exactly 8 complete full-body poses of the SAME Rousong cat, exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, reading order left-to-right then next row. Desired 2048x1024 canvas, every cell 512x512, large transparent gutters, no text or grid lines. Fixed camera at low cat eye level, three-quarter rightward view; same natural photographic lighting, markings, adult proportions, physical scale and camera in every cell. Eight consecutive poses of a REAL cat stretch: (1) relaxed seated cat same identity, (2) rising to stand and leaning forward, (3) forepaws stepping forward with elbows beginning to straighten, (4) deep forward bow with long outstretched forelegs, chest close to floor and hips high, (5) same deep bow holding stretch, toes spread and head low, (6) pulling the front paws back and raising chest while hips begin to lower, (7) relaxed four-paw standing with spine and head back up, (8) returning to relaxed seated posture. The silhouette MUST visibly change through shoulder, elbow, spinal and hip movement, not eight nearly identical seated poses. Clean realistic anatomy, no extra paws or legs, whole tail included. Do not copy the other cat or grass/wall from motion reference. Rousong only, no props, no floor, no shadows, no background, no labels or watermarks, truly transparent alpha, no red/yellow fringe. Each cat is contained within its own cell with at least 35px safety padding. Consistent body size across all poses even though sitting and bowing have different silhouette dimensions.
